But the narrative contains claims that conflict with the evidence and an internal inconsistency, so an investigator would have to redo some analysis.","problems":["Claims 'the provider bills above peers within nearly every complexity group' but the card shows 0-condition visits at 0.024 vs 0.022 and 1-condition at 0.051 vs 0.034, while the summary also says 0-1 condition visits 'run close to peer rates'; these statements are in tension.","Says '3-condition and 5+ condition groups carry shares well above the all-provider rates' but the 4-condition group (0.156 vs 0.118) is also elevated; the characterization is selective, and the 5+ at 2x and 3-cond at 2.4x suggest the excess is large, undermining the 'more consistent with a sicker panel' lean given the risk-adjusted ratio of 2.89.","The 'more consistent with a sicker panel' conclusion is in tension with the risk-adjusted score of 4.57 and 2.89x expected share that already adjust for complexity; the summary does not reconcile this.","The 'example claims' section cites C0100364 and C0100377 as low-complexity 99215s, but the cited ids in the text (C0100740, C0100141, C0100585, C0100633 etc.) are not all in cited_claim_ids, making the citation list incomplete.","The 99214 'above the comparison rate' claim rests on 2 of 21 documented claims; flagged as a small base, but still used to recommend a look.","Next steps are generic (request larger sample, re-screen) and omit the specific cited claims; the rationale's more specific steps (prioritize low-complexity 99215s, check templated notes) are not in next_steps.","Did not flag that only 1 of 20 data-reviewed notes lacked a lab line is a weak signal; interpretation is left unexplained."]}
